scope: Standing Sasanian ruin at Iraj Castle, Pishva. The complete mapped four-sided enceinte includes surviving stepped earth and mudbrick curtains, eroded round tower remnants, the southeastern gateway sector and open interior.

references.caption:
Iran, Iraj Castle. 

Iraj Castle is located to the north-east of Varamin and near Ja'far Abad in north of Iran. Nowadays main gate remains. Iraj Castle is one of the significant castles of adobe with a height of 50 feet, an area of 200 hectares. It was constructed during the Sassanid Empire. This rectangular structure is made of mud and sun baked bricks. Dimensions: 1440 m x 1280 m.(Wikipedia)

originalReview.notes: The 2011 geotagged photograph shows the southwestern wall, tall eroded tower bulges, soft weathered clay colors and sloped rubble skirts. Dark openings and broken wall tops guide surviving character around the photographed side.
